mod.autoattacker.name: Combat Helper
mod.autoattacker.description:
A comprehensive combat assistant for maximizing attack speed DPS, special weapon beams, bow ballistics, and modern firearm tactical fire control.

Features:
- Automatic timed melee attacks & beam release
- Automatic full-power bow shooting
- Firearm aim assist, triggerbot & packet-safe reload
- Runge-Kutta numerical lead prediction & 3D indicator
- Side-drawer dark tactical console
config.autoattacker.enable_mod.tooltip: Main master switch. If disabled, all features including auto-attack and lock-on will be deactivated.
config.autoattacker.enable_auto_attack.t: When enabled, holding the attack key will auto-swing only when fully charged to maximize damage per hit.
config.autoattacker.enable_auto_shoot.to: When enabled, holding the use key with a bow will automatically release the arrow once fully drawn.
config.autoattacker.enable_aim_assist.to: When enabled, use the hotkey to automatically track and lock onto the nearest enemy.
config.autoattacker.aim_assist_range.too: The maximum radius in blocks to search for potential lock-on targets.
config.autoattacker.aim_assist_speed.too: The smoothness of camera rotation. Higher values result in faster tracking. 0.15 is recommended.
config.autoattacker.aim_assist_mode.tool: HOLD: Lock is active only while the key is pressed. TOGGLE: Press once to lock, press again to unlock.
config.autoattacker.enable_lock_particle: Show visual effects around the locked target to help identify it in crowds.
config.autoattacker.lock_particle_type.t: Choose the visual style for highlighting your current target.
config.autoattacker.blacklist.tooltip: Auto-attack will be disabled when holding any item or tag specified in this list.
config.autoattacker.whitelist.tooltip: Force enable auto-attack for items in this list, even if they are not standard weapons.
config.autoattacker.entity_blacklist.too: Entities in this list (e.g., 'minecraft:villager' or 'minecraft:player') will be ignored by both lock-on and auto-attack.
config.autoattacker.General_Settings.too: Configure core features like auto-attack and auto-shoot.
config.autoattacker.Lock_On_Settings.too: Configure aim assist logic and visual feedback.
config.autoattacker.target_part.tooltip: Target body part for aim assist: HEAD (headshot priority), TORSO (body center), ADAPTIVE (smart distance switch).
config.autoattacker.List_Settings.toolti: Configure item and entity filtering rules.
